title: The Buckingham house at Prairie and 21st Street
items: 2036 Prairie, the Ebenezer Buckingham house on the 21st Street corner, is no longer a rough draft: a red-brick house over a stone basement under a slate mansard, its corner cut on a slant, a bay on each side, and a stone porch at the head of a stoop with turned stone balusters. Its 21st Street side follows an engraving of about 1880: tall windows under carved hoods, a stone sill course, a barred basement window. The iron fence the engraving draws along 21st Street comes next.
